svg.title: Dash 8-300 fuselage section
svg.desc: Schematic vector tracing of the fuselage section in the supplied Q300 Model 311 Airport Planning Manual, Figure 2-5, sheet 1. Nose right; aft section cut at left. Seats, cabin partitions and hold outlines intentionally omitted for dynamic overlays. Not a complete aircraft silhouette. Calibrated by the labelled station X109 and X577.28 anchors; aft endpoint is a section cut.
svg.metadata: Source: D8_300.pdf page 1, Figure 2-5, 27 July 2001. Tracing coordinates based on 1800-pixel page render. Station X109 anchor at source x509; X577.28 anchor at source x1214. Draft source pixels per station inch: 705/468.28. Display transform x=1470-sourceX, y=sourceY-600. Datum-to-nose distance is not established by this draft. Aft cut is not the aircraft tail.
